svg.title: Follow one request through four evidence boundaries
svg.desc: Read down the same customer attempt: resolver and DNS answer, edge cache or web filter, origin route and target, then application permission and stored result. Each receipt answers a narrower question. A missing or unmatched observation remains unknown; it does not prove an earlier stage succeeded. This is an investigation guide, not a deployed AWS route.
svg.text: Match time, destination and safe request ID.
Which address did this customer use?
A resolver cache may hide a DNS query.
Was content cached, forwarded or blocked?
A cache hit need not reach the origin.
Did the flow reach the selected target?
Flow ACCEPT does not prove success.
Was the action allowed and result stored?
HTTP success alone is not the outcome.
